# Vulcan SDK

> Vulcan SDK is a zero-dependency, production-grade AI Agent framework for TypeScript.
> Web: https://vulcan-sdk.itsrahulr15.online
> npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vulcan-agentic-sdk
> GitHub: https://github.com/its-rahul-r15/VULCAN-SDK

## Overview

Vulcan SDK provides type-safe tools with Zod validation, cycle-blocked multi-agent handoffs, human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates, per-run structured tracing, safety guardrails, and real-time SSE event streaming. It seamlessly supports Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Anthropic Claude.

## Core Capabilities

- **Type-safe Tool Calling**: Automatic Zod argument validation before execution handlers run.
- **Built-in Production Tools**: Web Search (Tavily), Web Scraper, JS Code Sandbox, Read-only SQL, and Vector RAG retriever.
- **Multi-Agent Handoffs**: Declarative delegation with built-in infinite cycle detection.
- **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**: Operator authorization thresholds before critical execution.
- **Safety Guardrails**: Input/output border checks, PII scrubber, keyword blocker, and async validators.
- **Structured Tracing**: JSON and terminal pretty-printed execution traces per run.
- **Session Memory**: Persistent conversation history backed by SQLite or custom storage adapters.
- **Event Streaming**: Async iterable stream API for real-time UI updates.

## Quick Example

```typescript
import { Vulcan, z } from 'vulcan-agentic-sdk'

const searchTool = Vulcan.createTool({
  name: 'search',
  inputSchema: z.object({ query: z.string() }),
  async execute({ query }) {
    return { results: [`Result for ${query}`] }
  }
})

const agent = Vulcan.createAgent({
  name: 'assistant',
  instructions: 'You are a helpful assistant.',
  tools: [searchTool],
})

const { output } = await Vulcan.run(agent, 'Find latest AI news')
console.log(output)
```
